children.html:
Dive Into Certification

PADI Courses at Mocean Beach Resort

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-1acfbbd8 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Mocean Beach Resort offers world-class PADI diving courses in the pristine waters of West Sumbawa. From beginner to divemaster, our courses provide the skills, knowledge, and confidence you need for safe and unforgettable underwater adventures. With just two certified divers per guide, personalized attention ensures every lesson is effective and enjoyable. Our diver-designed center features private lockers, a dedicated wet area, and an air-conditioned camera room. Explore the underwater world and gain an internationally recognized scuba diving certification course with Mocean’s PADI programs.

Your PADI Journey

Dive Courses & Packages

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-48920eed elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html:
Each PADI course is carefully structured to build your skills progressively. Beginners can start with Discover Scuba Diving or Bubble Maker programs, while certified divers can advance with Open Water, Advanced Open Water, Rescue Diver, or specialty courses. Courses include pool sessions, beach dives, and boat dives. Multi-day packages range from three-day introductory courses to ten-day full certifications, offering flexibility and immersive experiences. All courses are led by experienced instructors who prioritize safety, learning, and fun. Completing these programs ensures you earn a recognized diving license in Indonesia, opening doors to dive sites across the archipelago.

Course prices: Discover Scuba Diving from IDR 1,980,000 · Open Water IDR 7,590,000 · Advanced Open Water IDR 8,470,000 · Rescue Diver with EFR IDR 7,370,000. See all course prices.

Relax, Recharge, and Discover Sumbawa

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-638b6bde elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Your dive adventure doesn’t end when you surface. Mocean Beach Resort offers quiet beaches, breathtaking sunsets, and easy access to Sumbawa’s hidden gems. Spend an afternoon exploring nearby villages, trek to cascading waterfalls, or simply unwind with a massage after a day of diving. Whether you crave exploration or pure relaxation, our boutique setting lets you enjoy Indonesia’s natural beauty at your own pace. Every stay is designed to refresh your body and inspire your next dive.

Experience More Than Diving

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-1bdd2ad5 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Beyond the crystal-clear waters, Sumbawa invites you to explore its wild side. Hike scenic coastal trails, visit traditional fishing villages, or take a day trip to secluded beaches where you can swim, snorkel, and soak in untouched beauty. For those seeking culture, local markets and ceremonies reveal the island’s rich heritage. Whether you’re chasing adrenaline or peaceful escapes, every moment here adds a new layer to your Indonesian journey.

children.html:
Do I need previous diving experience?

No. We offer courses for all levels, from beginners in Discover Scuba Diving to advanced Open Water and specialty programs.

What PADI certifications can I earn at Mocean?

Courses range from Open Water to Advanced Open Water, Rescue Diver, Peak Performance Buoyancy, and Divemaster certifications.

How large are the dive groups?

We limit groups to a maximum of two certified divers per instructor for personalized guidance and a safe learning environment.

Is equipment provided for courses?

Yes. Our dive center provides quality gear, plus private lockers and a temperature-controlled camera room for your equipment and footage.

What else can I do besides diving?

Beyond the water, enjoy quiet beaches, massage, coastal hikes, local villages, waterfalls, and cultural experiences across Sumbawa
